operations.rationale: Separate scope-definition acquisition from oral-form and identification acquisition so unrelated query families are not union-delivered. The expanded definitional variants cover recurring formulations and previously inaccessible scope witnesses, including the distinct formulations in 421, 522, 230, 364 and 304.

operations.rationale: Identification evidence was previously mixed with definition and oral-form windows. Atomic searches now expose positive requirements, notification alternatives, presumptions and express non-identification language without broadcasting them to other hypotheses.

any_phrases: disclosed either visually orally or in writing

operations.rationale: Oral-form acquisition is independently responsive and no longer receives marking or broad scope searches. Added compact recurrent form-enumeration variants cover later sources while preserving exact source text.

The library had no source-acquisition action for this hypothesis, and both observed witnesses were outside program access. The query covers conventional technical restrictions and the distinct recreation formulation seen in training.

operations.rationale: Several later no-rights witnesses used transfer, implied-license, or intellectual-property-right wording absent from the direct query. These additions recover governing clauses in 619, 230, 364 and 304 without changing the acquisition purpose.

operations.rationale: Observed misses concentrated in personnel clauses using authorized-access, dissemination, recipient-personnel and enumerated adviser language. The enlarged local window retains governing qualifications and list members, addressing misses in 282, 522, 364, 619 and 304.

written notice of the order or request

operations.rationale: Notification clauses in 529, 619, 364 and 304 used recurring constructions not captured by the existing notice vocabulary. The additions acquire the notice witness together with its compelled-disclosure context rather than encoding a relation.

Plural-purpose, proper-performance and combined non-use/non-disclosure formulations caused inaccessible witnesses in 421, 230 and 304. The additions remain targeted to use restrictions and preserve adjacent governing context.

any_phrases: no further force or effect except
remain subject to the confidentiality obligations

operations.rationale: Added direct post-termination and expiration formulations to recover inaccessible survival clauses in 421 and 304. Removed the overly generic confidentiality-obligation phrase that directly hit a third-party condition in 529 and contributed noise unrelated to duration.

no copies will be made or retained

operations.rationale: Retention exceptions in 249, 619 and 364 were missed, while all-copy return provisions relevant to the same acquisition question were inaccessible in 422, 312 and 522. Added both exception and governing return formulations without treating either as a verdict.

any_phrases: not disclose publish reproduce or transmit
not to make or cause to be made any copies

operations.rationale: The prior long phrases missed shorter and syntactically distinct copy prohibitions in 421, 295 and 230. Added compact prohibition and permitted-copy variants while retaining surrounding conditions.

operations.rationale: Added recurring lawful-possession, rightful-receipt and alternative-source formulations. A larger preceding window supplies exclusion preambles and neighboring conditions that were omitted in 346, 125, 364 and 304.
